## Goal
The registry (`brokers/registry.yaml`) already holds about 428 brokers. Every scan writes one `exposure_check` event per searchable site plus one `exposure_scan` event (`engine/exposure.py:686-692`, `703-731`), and `_scan_events` reads the newest 5000 events of all kinds and filters them in Python (`exposure.py:734-735`) because `Store.events` can filter only by person and broker (`storage/db.py:372-382`). So `latest_exposure`, which needs one event, decodes and decrypts up to 5000 rows on every dashboard open, and a trend or first-scan lookup stops seeing scans after about a dozen runs. Make the read adaptive: `_scan_events(store, profile_id, limit=5000, want=None)` reads windows of 300, 1200, then `limit`, stopping as soon as `want` scan events are found (`want=1` for `latest_exposure`; `None` keeps today's "everything in the window" for trend and history). Public functions and results are unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. With a fake store that counts rows returned, `latest_exposure` on a history where the newest scan event is within the first 300 rows reads 300 rows, not 5000.
2. When the newest scan is beyond row 300 but inside 1200, it reads at most 300 + 1200 rows and returns the same result as before.
3. `exposure_history` and `exposure_trend` return exactly what they returned before for the same fake histories (golden comparison on 3 histories of different shapes).
4. A store with no scan events returns None/empty after reading at most `limit` rows once (no loop beyond the largest window).
5. The reads are newest-first slices of the same ordered list (the fake store verifies each call uses a larger limit, never an offset).
6. Existing exposure, trend and WO-401 tests pass unchanged.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.

WO-279 (blocked, same file) is not a prerequisite: if in-house unblocks WO-279 first, in-house gives it an order line after this WO (and the other queued WOs on `engine/exposure.py`) so the two never edit the file at once.
